item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to receive 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: Riviera Beach was selected as one of just 10 communities nationwide to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League, making it the only Florida city recognized this year.

item.title: Palm Beach County schools earn third consecutive 'A' rating from state

item.title: Breast cancer patient speaks out after Anthem denies coverage hours before reconstruction surgery
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, was diagnosed with invasive ductal carcinoma three months ago. Less than 24 hours before her reconstruction surgery, her insurance company, Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield, denied coverage for the procedure.

item.title: Boca Raton High School band to represent Florida at National Independence Day Parade

item.title: Juno Beach residents demand new fence at JB-7 beach access as costs could reach thousands
item.description: Residents at the Colony Condos say beachgoers using the JB-7 public walkway are cutting through their private property since the town removed the old fence in 2023. The town council will address the issue in budget discussions on July 15.
